question.problem: Suppose that $|\,p\,|=8$, $|\,q\,|=4$ and that the angle between the vectors is $\theta =\frac{\pi }{4}.$ Find the vector projection of $p$ onto $q$ in terms of the vector $q.$
question.worked_solution:
First, we find the scalar projection as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{comp}}_{q}\,p & =|\,p\,|\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  \\  & =8\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{\pi }{4}) \\  & =8\cdot \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \\  & =4\sqrt{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we find the unit vector that is parallel to $q:$

$$
u=\frac{q}{|\,q\,|}=\frac{q}{4}=\frac{1}{4}q
$$

Finally, we compute the vector projection as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{b}\,p & ={\text{comp}}_{q}\,p\cdot u \\  & =4\sqrt{2}\cdot \frac{1}{4}q \\  & =\sqrt{2}q\end{aligned}
$$
